install_tell: pip install trulens trulens-apps-langchain; run_dashboard() launches Streamlit on port 8501
misconfig_patterns: Streamlit dashboard has no authentication layer — anyone who can reach port 8501 sees all trace data
Default SQLite database (default.sqlite in cwd) readable by any local process
PHOENIX_HOST-equivalent not present — Streamlit binds to 0.0.0.0 by default, exposing dashboard network-wide
PostgreSQL or Snowflake backend credentials in TruSession() database_url logged in plaintext if debug enabled
No TLS on Streamlit dashboard — credentials and trace data transmitted cleartext

active_probe.false_positive_check: Port 8501 is generic Streamlit default; response must contain 'TruLens' or 'Leaderboard' in body — not just Streamlit markers

deployment_tells: Streamlit app on port 8501 with 'TruLens' and 'Leaderboard' in page body
SQLite file default.sqlite in working directory
run_dashboard() Python call in application code
pivot_paths: GET / on port 8501 -> Leaderboard page shows all app versions, feedback scores, trace counts without auth
Evaluations page -> individual trace records including full input/output messages to LLM
SQLite file access (if local) -> direct SQL query of all OTEL spans including prompts and completions
TruSession database_url -> PostgreSQL/MySQL backend with full evaluation and trace history
